walk_forward.training: Expanding observed prefix; parameters frozen, no optimization; fold positions start in cash and liquidate at fold end.

promotion: No automatic live promotion. Previously inspected historical data and current-constituent bias cannot establish virgin OOS performance. Require adequate sample, positive expectancy under base and stress costs, positive risk-adjusted improvement with multiplicity-aware uncertainty, stable folds and new prospective observations. Win rate alone never authorizes adoption.

independent_engine_rules.early_reversal: Close reclaims EMA20 or exceeds prior five-session high; RSI >=40 and rising, MACD histogram improving; rising confirmed lows plus either ATR contraction or stronger up-volume. RS20 improving over five sessions and RS60 > -10 percentage points; no EMA200 requirement.
independent_engine_rules.trend_pullback: Close > EMA50 > EMA200, EMA50 rising over ten sessions; low touched EMA20+0.5ATR within preceding five sessions; bullish close above prior high; RSI 45-70; RS20 and RS60 positive, RS120 nonnegative; higher lows or contraction supports the pullback.
independent_engine_rules.breakout_retest: An earlier close broke its prior 20-session high within ten sessions; today tests that frozen level within 0.5ATR and closes above it and prior close; intervening closes >=98% of level; current price >EMA50; RS20 and RS60 positive, RS120 nonnegative; contraction or rising confirmed lows supports setup.

target_policy: Nearest overhead confirmed pivot zone with >=3 touches; otherwise prior 126-session high. Never ignore a nearer major zone to manufacture 10% upside. Fibonacci is reported only as supporting context, not evidence of predictability or a mandatory entry gate.
limitations: Only current 254 stocks are available, with no complete delisted or point-in-time constituent history; survivorship bias cannot be removed.
Vendor adjusted history is retrospective, with no complete raw corporate-action ledger or point-in-time adjustment vintages.
Known historical test results remain reused retrospective evidence; only post-registration shadow observations are genuinely prospective.
Minimum counts are conservative governance choices, not statistical guarantees.
